validity.recommendation: Leave Diameter blank on this row. Do NOT fill from the gem.wiki infobox's system-wide diameter list -- it describes the whole FGT mainline, not this segment. The Southwest Alabama Project (II) lays no new pipe: it is a compressor-unit uprate at an existing station.
validity.researcher_notes: FGT's Southwest Alabama Project II is Docket No. CP23-2-000 (prior notice filed 2022-10-11, published in the Federal Register 2022-10-21) -- 'authorization to increase its mainline capacity, replace and uprate an Electric Motor Drive and related appurtenances on compressor unit 1111 ... at FGT's existing Compressor Station 11, in Mobile County, Alabama,' moving incremental interstate gas from an existing receipt point in George County, Mississippi to an existing delivery point in Escambia County, Alabama -- an electric-motor-drive uprate at an existing compressor station, not new pipe. Independently, Alabama ADEM's air-permit statement of basis for Compressor Station 11 (dated Feb 2026, covering the same facility) describes 'Florida Gas is requesting to uprate two existing electric motors Nos. 1110-1111' with 'no modifications to or additions of significant emission sources' -- a state environmental-agency record of the SAME underlying compressor uprate (units 1110-1111 matches 'compressor unit 1111' in the FERC notice), independently confirming no new construction. The sheet's SegmentName reads 'Southwest Alabama Project' without the 'II'; I found no separately FR-published 'Southwest Alabama Project' (I) docket, so I am treating this as the same project referred to with a shortened segment name -- flagging that naming discrepancy for a human to confirm, not something that changes the Diameter call. StartYear1=2022 on the sheet matches the docket's 2022 filing year. Per standing rule 'expansion with no new physical pipe -> LengthKnown=0, Diameter=blank', both fields are already correct as recorded.
